tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background (html/body) and the Nav/Footer ground. White `text`, `text-secondary` and `gold` all read on it.

tokens.name: bg-primary
tokens.usage: Alternate near-black ground declared by the site; reserved for full-bleed sections that need a hair of separation from `bg`.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs and banded sections (the Mobs strip). Sits on `bg` with a `border` hairline.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Raised layer inside a `surface` card (nested panels, hover fills).

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Highest neutral layer; use sparingly for pressed/active fills on `surface-2`.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on every ground (20:1 on `bg`, 15.5:1 on `surface-3`).

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Body copy, nav links, footer links on `bg` and all surfaces (7.8:1 on `bg`, 6:1 on `surface-3`).

tokens.name: text-dim
tokens.usage: Labels, captions, legal lines, the 'Corp' tag. 4.1:1 on `bg` and 3.8:1 on `surface`: below 4.5:1, so keep it to 11–13px uppercase labels or metadata, never running copy. Kept exact from source.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Default 1px hairline for cards, dividers, the Nav bottom edge and secondary buttons. Decorative (1.3:1 on `bg`): never the only cue for a control.

tokens.name: border-light
tokens.usage: Hover border for cards and secondary buttons.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: AMA Gold. Primary button fill, the mark's square, eyebrow labels, focus ring, accent words in headlines. 8.3:1 on `bg`; `bg` ink on gold is 8.3:1.

tokens.name: gold-light
tokens.usage: Primary button hover fill, active nav text, gold badge text (10.9:1 on `bg`).

tokens.name: gold-dim
tokens.usage: Gold-card hover border, Mob numerals, footer 'Contact us' link. 4.1:1 on `bg`: under 4.5:1, so use for small accents and borders, not paragraphs. Kept exact from source.

tokens.name: gold-glow
tokens.usage: Soft gold halo: icon tiles in value cards, the primary button hover shadow, gold-card hover shadow.

tokens.name: gold-glow-sm
tokens.usage: Faintest gold wash: active nav pill background.

tokens.name: brand-obsidian
tokens.usage: PROVISIONAL (brand handoff v1.0, not yet sampled from the approved badge). Primary dark field for brand covers, decks and dark documents. `brand-warm-white` (17.7:1), `brand-soft-white` and `brand-champagne-gold` (9.4:1) read on it.

tokens.name: brand-charcoal
tokens.usage: PROVISIONAL (brand handoff v1.0, not yet sampled from the approved badge). Cards, panels and document blocks on `brand-obsidian`. `brand-soft-white` 14:1, `brand-champagne-gold` 8.6:1.

tokens.name: brand-warm-white
tokens.usage: PROVISIONAL (brand handoff v1.0, not yet sampled from the approved badge). Primary light field and paper: letterhead, invoices, contracts. Body text on it is `brand-obsidian` (17.7:1).

tokens.name: brand-soft-white
tokens.usage: PROVISIONAL (brand handoff v1.0, not yet sampled from the approved badge). Secondary text on `brand-obsidian` and `brand-charcoal` (15.5:1 / 14:1). Never on `brand-warm-white` (1.1:1).

tokens.name: brand-champagne-gold
tokens.usage: PROVISIONAL (brand handoff v1.0, not yet sampled from the approved badge). Primary brand accent: rules, highlights, emblem-adjacent details on dark grounds (9.4:1 on `brand-obsidian`). Fails on paper (1.9:1 on `brand-warm-white`): on light grounds use it only for decorative rules, never text or meaningful marks. Text on a champagne fill is `brand-obsidian`.

tokens.name: brand-deep-gold
tokens.usage: PROVISIONAL (brand handoff v1.0, not yet sampled from the approved badge). Print shadow and gold accent on light grounds. 4.15:1 on `brand-warm-white`: below 4.5:1, so only 24px+ headings, rules or icons there; 4.3:1 on `brand-obsidian`, same limit.

tokens.name: brand-muted-gold
tokens.usage: PROVISIONAL (brand handoff v1.0, not yet sampled from the approved badge). Secondary labels and dividers on dark grounds (7:1 on `brand-obsidian`). 2.5:1 on paper: dividers only there.

tokens.name: brand-slate
tokens.usage: PROVISIONAL (brand handoff v1.0, not yet sampled from the approved badge). Secondary copy on light backgrounds per the brief, but 4.2:1 on `brand-warm-white`: below 4.5:1, so limit to 18px+ or bold 14px+ until a darker value is approved.

tokens.name: status-green
tokens.usage: PROVISIONAL (brand handoff v1.0, not yet sampled from the approved badge). Positive status only, always with a label and icon. 4.6:1 on `brand-warm-white`; 3.9:1 on `brand-obsidian` (icons/borders only there). Nearly the same lightness as `status-red`: never tell them apart by colour alone.

tokens.name: status-amber
tokens.usage: PROVISIONAL (brand handoff v1.0, not yet sampled from the approved badge). Pending / attention status only, with label and icon. 4.0:1 on `brand-warm-white` and 4.4:1 on `brand-obsidian`: use for icons, borders and 18px+ text; smaller text in the neutral ink beside the icon.

tokens.name: status-red
tokens.usage: PROVISIONAL (brand handoff v1.0, not yet sampled from the approved badge). Error / stop status only, with label and icon. 5.2:1 on `brand-warm-white`; 3.4:1 on `brand-obsidian` (icons/borders only there).

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero headline only. Fluid in code: clamp(48px, 8vw, 88px).

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Page titles on inner pages. Fluid: clamp(36px, 5.5vw, 64px).

styles.name: display-sm
styles.usage: Card titles and h3. Fluid: clamp(22px, 3vw, 32px).

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: 'AMA Solutions' wordmark beside the mark in Nav and Footer.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Document default: html is set in JetBrains Mono at 16/1.6.

styles.name: body-mono
styles.usage: Paragraphs and card body copy in `text-secondary`.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Footer blurb, footer links, newsletter copy.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button labels, uppercase (`btn-primary`, `btn-secondary`). Nav CTA drops to 11px.

styles.name: label-mono
styles.usage: Eyebrows, group labels, badges (badges use 0.1em). Always uppercase.

styles.name: doc-title
styles.usage: PROPOSED, pending founder approval. Document and deck titles, executive statements. Source Serif 4 (OFL, Google Fonts).

styles.name: doc-h1
styles.usage: PROPOSED. Section titles in proposals, briefs, decks.

styles.name: doc-h2
styles.usage: PROPOSED. Sub-sections and table group headings. IBM Plex Sans (OFL, Google Fonts).

styles.name: doc-body
styles.usage: PROPOSED. Website body, forms, contracts, operational documents (print: 10.5pt).

styles.name: doc-small
styles.usage: PROPOSED. Captions, footnotes, invoice terms. Never below 12px on screen or 8pt in print.

styles.name: doc-label
styles.usage: PROPOSED. Uppercase metadata: document IDs, dates, status labels, folios. JetBrains Mono (already on the website).

styles.name: doc-table
styles.usage: PROPOSED. Tabular figures in invoices, line items, logs.

tokens.name: spacing-base
tokens.usage: Base unit; icon/label gaps inside buttons and badges.

tokens.name: spacing-gap
tokens.usage: Default gap between grid items and stacked controls.

tokens.name: spacing-card
tokens.usage: Card padding; also the container's side gutter.

tokens.name: spacing-section
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of every `.section`.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Skip link, hamburger button, small chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inner panels and Mob tiles.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards and large panels: the signature soft-rectangle.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Declared for controls; buttons in practice use `radius-pill`.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, badges, nav pills.

tokens.name: shadow-card-hover
tokens.usage: Neutral card on hover, with a 2px lift.

tokens.name: shadow-card-gold-hover
tokens.usage: `card-gold` on hover.

tokens.name: shadow-btn-primary-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover glow.
